feature_name: In-place update of deployed model scaling and container logging settings
summary: Vertex AI Prediction now allows updating certain scaling and container logging configuration settings on a DeployedModel without undeploying and redeploying it to an endpoint.
extended_definition: Vertex AI Prediction now allows updating certain scaling and container logging configuration settings on a DeployedModel without undeploying and redeploying it to an endpoint.
